listings.description: The luxurious shades of gray come together in a blend of elegance and tranquility. The collection includes White Regent with its refined purity, Emerald with its captivating warmth, and Gray with its enchanting mystery. A complete experience that embodies serenity of the senses and offers a presence of refined grace that never fades with time. Grey Box 2 (75 mL): · White Regent · Emerald Soul · Nude Coral

Introducing Malayan Leather by IBRAQ (Ibrahim Al Qurashi), just like this magnificent feline, the scent exudes power, elegance, and an undeniable allure The Malayan tiger embodies harmonious coexistence within its natural habitat, where beauty and fierceness come together. This fragrance is both fierce and mysterious, inviting you to embrace your own inner strength and unleash your true harmonious self. 75 mL Fragrance Notes: Top Notes: Raspberry, Lychee, Red Berries, Red Currant Heart Notes: Saffron, Rose, Violet, Olibanum Base Notes: Oud, Leather, Sandalwood, Amber, Patchouli

VICUÑA LTHR by IBRAQ (Ibrahim Al Qurashi) takes you on a journey through the heart of the Andes, embodying the spirit of this rare creature with its soft, dense fleece known for its warmth and finesse. With its long-lasting silage and captivating presence, the fragrance leaves an unforgettable impression, much like the memory of encountering the graceful vicuña in its natural habitat. VICUÑA LTHR is not just a scent; it’s a rich experience that embodies strength and timeless beauty, with an air of luxury that lingers with you throughout the day. 75 mL Fragrance Notes: Top Notes: Lavender, Bergamot, Cardamom, Coriander, Clary Sage Heart Notes: Orris, Carnation, Cinnamon, Olibanum, Myrrh, Cocoa Base Notes: Musk, Amber, Vetiver, Cedarwood, Patchouli, Tonka Bean

Inspired by the graceful and timeless presence of the manta rays, Manta LTHR by IBRAQ (Ibrahim Al Qurashi) captures the essence of eternal beauty and enduring allure. Just as these majestic creatures glide through the oceans, untouched by time, this fragrance embodies the same sense of sophistication and lasting charm. The manta ray’s ageless grace symbolizes a beauty that transcends generations, and with each spritz of Timeless | Manta, you are transported to a world where time ceases to exist, leaving only the aura of timeless elegance. This fragrance pays tribute to the manta rays, encouraging us to embrace the eternal and the beauty that defies time. Fragrance Notes: TOP NOTES - TROPICAL FRUITS, SAFFRON, BLACKCURRANT HEART NOTES - RASPBERRY, OUD WOOD, BENZOIN BASE NOTES - PATCHOULI, VANILLA, LEATHERY, AMBER

A fragrance that energizes and propels you forward. Each note awakens your senses. It opens spicy and fresh, flows into an earthy spicy heart note, and finishes with a sweet warm base that boosts confidence. Ideal for active days and moments when you need a push. 100 ml Notes: Top Notes: Bergamot, cardamom, lavender Heart Notes: Vetiver, cinnamon, black pepper Base Notes: Vanilla, tonka bean, cedarwood

A soft summer breeze that gently embraces you, calm yet deeply present. It starts with elegant Damask rose, flows into a creamy woody heart note, and ends with a warm touch of amber and musk. A soft daily option, ideal for spring and long workdays. 100 ml Notes: Top Notes: Damask rose Heart Notes: Sandalwood, Cashmeran Base Notes: Amber, musk

In the depth of the sea, coral dances silently with the waves. A fresh daytime scent, perfect for hot weather and casual gatherings. 100 ml Fragrance Notes: Top Notes: Mandarin, coriander, peach, jasmine, rose Heart Notes: Clove, orange blossom Base Notes: White musk, sandalwood, vanilla

Like the first rays of sunlight, the scent rises with soft brightness. Citrus and blackcurrant create vibrant freshness, followed by a warm floral bouquet and a luxurious base of vanilla and amber. A fresh, lively fragrance that defies gravity, like a cold dew drop formed in the early morning hours on lavender flowers, to spread it on everyone who passed by, to fill the place with joy and freshness. Then be dancing with a cold breeze infused with pure floral scents, let you melt as fresh as a small ice cube. To finally settle on your hands as a fragrance rich in the scents of mint and elegant leather that takes your senses away to a world full of beauty to bring you inner peace and refreshing joy for the soul. A fragrance embodying magical elegance and luxury. Blending iris and warm woods with succulent fruits creates a stunning mixture of beauty in its most splendid form. This perfume envelops you with enchanting allure, captivating your senses with unparalleled elegance—your perfect companion for every occasion. Simply put, it creates irresistible attraction. Notes Top: Ginger, Lemon, Mandarin, Black Pepper, Iris Heart: Bergamot, Vetiver, Paradisone Base: Cedar Wood, Patchouli

In the midst of calm and refreshing lavender fields, you will find yourself surrounded by a luxurious bouquet of vanilla flowers wrapped in a piece of leather, while your senses will be flooded with the scent of iris flowers harmonious with many attractive ingredients to soothe your soul with an aromatic scent full of luxury. Just as the moon completes itself through its phases, the story is completed through three fragrances. The Moon Collection by IBRAQ embodies the beauty of the moon in three olfactory expressions: the Crescent, the Half Moon, and the Full Moon, a gradual presence from the first light to its full radiance. Crescent (10 ml): Taif rose, frankincense, and a touch of cinnamon. A balanced heart resting on a warm base of sandalwood, musk, and amber. A soft beginning with clear longevity. Half Moon (15 ml): An elegant woody opening that unfolds into well-balanced notes, settling on a deep base of patchouli and frankincense. For a calm and confident character. Full Moon (20 ml): Cardamom, musk, and a touch of saffron. A warm heart with hints of caramel and amber, finishing with a luxurious smoky trail. The fragrance of completion — when presence shines.

Powder Musk EDP is an amazing duo of musk and soft powdery notes, created in an aromatic blend that feels clean, fresh, and elegant. It opens with a smooth, airy character that gives lasting freshness throughout the day. Vanilla, amber, and enchanting cedar wood move through its layers to add warmth and a soft touch that lingers beautifully. This edp is designed for those who enjoy a refined scent profile with a gentle powdery finish. Its 75ml size is practical for daily wear and easy to keep as part of your fragrance collection. The composition feels polished and easy to wear, with a soft trail that stays comforting without becoming heavy. It suits moments when you want something clean, smooth, and quietly distinctive from morning to evening. The blend highlights powdery elegance while allowing the warmer elements to bring depth and balance to the scent. It can fit into a daily routine just as easily as it can complement more special occasions. Apply to pulse points such as the neck and wrists for a more noticeable trail. For best care, store it away from direct heat and sunlight to help preserve its character. Fragrance Notes of Powder Musk EDP This scent focuses on musk at its base, supported by creamy sweetness and elegant woods for a clean and comforting impression. The floral opening introduces a delicate brightness before the heart becomes smoother and more enveloping. Cedar Wood, Orris, and Amber create a gentle transition between freshness and warmth, giving the fragrance a graceful structure. The phrase elon musk refers to a public figure and is unrelated to this fragrance, which remains centered on soft powdery perfume notes. Altogether, the musk signature, powdery feel, and warm accents shape an edp that feels refined and memorable. Notes: Top notes: Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang, Rose.Heart notes: Cedar Wood, Orris, Amber.Base notes: Musk, Vanilla, Tonka Bean and Powder.

French Avenue Coconut Leche captures the soft indulgence of a coconut truffle - creamy, airy, and deliciously refined. It opens with the smooth sweetness of toasted coconut wrapped in delicate vanilla cream, evoking the scent of a freshly opened confection. A heart of velvety tuberose adds a floral silkiness that keeps it from tipping into pure dessert, giving the fragrance a sophisticated glow. As it settles, warm benzoin melts into the mix, creating a comforting finish that lingers like coconut milk on sun-kissed skin. Sweet, creamy, and effortlessly elegant - Coconut Leche is pure comfort in perfume form. Top Notes: Toasted Coconut Heart Notes: Tuberose Base Notes: Vanilla, Benzoin

Cocoa Morado Perfume 100ml EDP French Avenue is an oriental woody fragrance for men and women. Created for those who love deep, warm, and luxurious scents. It blends rich spices with sweet gourmand notes. Giving the perfume a bold and expressive character. The opening feels warm and inviting. And the heart grows darker, sweeter, and resinous. This perfume suits anyone who wants a scent that feels rich and unforgettable. Top notes Saffron, cinnamon, cardamom, ginger nutmegHeart notes : Dates, oud, caramel, amber wood, incenseBase notes Madagascar vanilla, tonka bean, cocoa butter, musk, leather, benzoin, labdanum.

French Avenue Zenith Santal Eau De Parfum (100ml) is an oriental woody EDP for both men and women, defined by its smooth warmth and understated elegance. Rich yet refined, it blends spice, woods and soft sweetness to create a comforting and sophisticated scent, ideal for cooler seasons and intimate settings. The fragrance opens with the warm, slightly spicy note of Saffron, setting a luxurious and inviting tone. As it develops, the heart reveals a soft, balanced blend of Lavender and creamy Chestnut, adding a gentle aromatic touch with a subtle gourmand warmth. The base settles into a comforting foundation of Sandalwood and Cedarwood, wrapped in smooth Vanilla, creating a warm, woody trail that lingers beautifully on the skin. Top Notes: Saffron. Heart Notes: Lavender and Chestnut. Base Notes: Sandalwood, Cedarwood and Vanilla.

French Avenue Vulcan Sable Eau De Parfum (100ml) is a bold, intoxicating EDP created for those who command attention and exude raw magnetism. Balancing fire and finesse, it blends mystery, warmth, and refined masculinity into an unforgettable olfactory statement. The opening bursts with warm Whiskey, aromatic Coriander, and the citrus brightness of Mandarin Orange, enriched with earthy Sesame and a subtle spice from Anise for a daring yet sophisticated introduction. The heart reveals a luxurious fusion of rich Cacao, creamy Sandalwood, and the velvety muskiness of Cashmeran, creating a seductive gourmand depth that is smooth, warm, and irresistibly addictive. In the dry-down, Tonka Bean and resinous Benzoin intertwine with smoky Styrax and soft White Cedar Extract, while Patchouli and Vanilla bring an earthy-sweet allure. Cashmere Wood completes the composition with a long-lasting, comforting finish. Top Notes: Whiskey, Coriander, Mandarin Orange, Sesame, and Anise. Heart Notes: Cacao, Sandalwood, and Cashmeran.
